comment.body: Engineering should investigate why no metrics appear on dashboards post-upgrade for observability beta customers. Check metrics ingestion, dashboard data sources, and recent deployment logs. Customer launch review is Friday, urgency required.

Thank you for reporting this issue. Our engineering team is actively investigating why dashboards are not showing metrics since the upgrade. We recognize the urgency with your upcoming launch review and will update you as soon as we have more information.

reply:
I triaged the open inbox according to the team plan:

- Ticket #4 ("Observability beta: dashboards show no metrics since upgrade") was an observability-beta incident. I updated its priority to urgent, added the "obs-beta" tag (preserving existing tags), and left a private investigation note for engineering. I then posted a public acknowledgment to the requester saying the team is investigating with urgency.

All other tickets were left unchanged, including the protected P0 non-beta security incident (#1). No private notes were disclosed. Work is complete per current policy.
